review_mode: Read-only source and existing report/pin inspection; AST syntax parse only, no imports or execution of sealers/tests

checks.finding: The validator requires one startup record, consistent physical flags, fixed upload size, real clock, and explicit physical session/executable/contract/provider bindings plus native authorization flags.
Every API return must pair with its intent, retain arguments, return status zero and preserve timing/stack accounting; exactly22fixed transmissions and the seed-derived key are checked.
Complete BF identity, seed, C1/C3 and transfer replies are assembled from bounded valid metadata/indicators; every transfer requires exact76 and checksum/framing integrity.

The non-read API schedule is checked exactly, including five SETs, immediate GET, broad filter, waits, baud, queue clears and final cleanup. Argument/output objects and resource handles are validated directly.
Minimum physical waits, immediate cleanup order and terminal counters/errors must agree; no later frame or retry can be accepted as a passing result.

The completed-session sealer requires exit, one invocation, user token, certificate/executable/contract bindings and post-exit client cleanup; it copies evidence before validation and preserves PASS or FAIL without retries.

The passive result sealer requires exactly120samples of the six addresses, BF identity2F12515306, PASS_CAPTURE_ONLY, clean observer exit and post-exit client scan; exact wire requests are oneBF and120A8 only.
OEM return is reported independently for either recorded upload PASS or FAIL. It seals artifacts and returns to offline-only scope without starting another operation.
The38tests reuse four saved fake journals, test all fifteen badACK boundaries and explicit synthetic physical envelopes/control mutations. No executable or provider runs in this test source.
